violations.description: The red billiard balls beside the cue have flattened, block-like and compressed outlines inconsistent with rigid spherical balls.
The white-and-blue billiard ball just left of the rightmost ball is stretched into an irregular pinched shape rather than retaining a rigid spherical outline.

notes: Inspected the eight-frame grid and enlarged frames 46 and 80. Motion blur and overlapping balls make some contacts ambiguous; no collision or gravity violation is assigned solely from overlap or airborne balls, and no unseen motion is inferred.
